Browser wait strategy 'selector' waits for specific CSS selector before considering page loaded

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'always', 'wait' => 'selector', 'wait_selector' => '#content' } }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.browser_used.inspect
puts result.status_code.inspect
```
